values.note: $20 a night for every single site (all have electric and water; the rate is a $15 camping fee plus $5 for electric). Senior and Access pass holders pay $12.50. Two Points group camp $35.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground ('$20/night for full service electric sites (27 available)', 'The fee for Pass-holders is $12.50/night', '$35/night for the Two Points Group Campground') + recreation.gov rates (RV ELECTRIC and STANDARD ELECTRIC $20 for 2026 and 2027 seasons) and facility fee description ('$15 basic camping fee and $5 electric fee'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground ('All campsites are fully accessible with water and electrical hook-ups') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (Electricity Hookup 30 or 50 on bookable sites, Water Hookup Yes; no sewer), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 27 RV sites with water and electric (30 or 50 amp) in the White Oak, Post Oak, Scarlet Oak and Pine Knob loops; six pull-throughs outside the host sites. Recreation.gov allows 38-62 ft on the bookable sites. Sites 2, 11, 19, 20 and 21 are designated for hosts or volunteers and not reservable. Plus the Two Points group camp.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground ('27 RV (includes Pine Knob Loop ) sites and one group site', 'Campsites 2, 11, 19, 20, and 21 are not reservable. The sites have been designated for hosts or volunteers') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (permitted_equipment max_length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Two flush restrooms with showers (registered campers only) and a vault restroom. Trails from the campground to the boat dock and Rock House.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground ('Two new flush restrooms with showers and one new vault restroom') + recreation.gov description ('accessible flush and vault toilets, showers and water hook-ups. A dump station is located on-site'; 'Registered campers only in shower facilities'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Open seasonally from early spring to fall'; recreation.gov's 2027 season is April 10 - October 11. Reopens for deer gun season only, when the Pine Knob loop is open first-come, first-served without water. Closed for the season as of October 2026, reopening spring 2027.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground ('Site Closed: Oak Hill Campground is closed for the season and will reopen in spring 2027', 'Opens outside of normal camping season for deer gun season only. During deer gun season, only the Pine Knob Loop is open for camping, but without water') + recreation.gov rates (Peak 2027-04-10 to 2027-10-11), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations must be made 4 days prior to arrival. Any unreserved campsites within the 4-day cut-off window are no longer reservable and only available on a first-come, first-serve basis.' No reservations in deer gun season. 14 days in any 30 on the Wayne National Forest. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 1 pm; two vehicles per site; no golf carts or alcohol.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground (quoted; 'No reservations are taken during the deer gun season') + recreation.gov facility_rules (reservationCutOff 4, maxStay 14 rolling 30 days) and notices (check-in/out, vehicles, golf carts, alcohol), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Pass holders pay $12.50 a night instead of $20.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/wayne/recreation/oak-hill-campground ('Senior Pass and Access Pass ... are accepted at this campground. The fee for Pass-holders is $12.50/night'), read 2026-10-30

note: Wayne National Forest (USFS), Lake Vesuvius Recreation Area (Ironton Ranger District). On a ridge on the west side of Lake Vesuvius; the Scarlet Oak Trail drops about 200 ft from the Scarlet Oak loop to the boat dock. --Claude
